from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """One record extracted from a Common Data Set document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university or college")
    enrollment_count: int | None = Field(description="Total student enrollment reported in Section B1 or similar")
    graduation_rate_2015: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort, as a percentage number; None if not available")
    report_cycle: str | None = Field(description="Reporting cycle or year associated with the document (e.g., '2021-2022', 'Fall 2015')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
